articles.title: Man Found Sleeping Inside SBI ATM in Hyderabad, Viral Video Raises Security Concerns
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing a man sleeping inside a State Bank of India (SBI) ATM kiosk near Peeli Dargah in Hyderabad's Borabanda has gone viral on social media, raising concerns over security and monitoring at the cash withdrawal centre.

body.html:
A video showing a man sleeping inside a State Bank of India (SBI) ATM kiosk near Peeli Dargah in Hyderabad's Borabanda has gone viral on social media, raising concerns over security and monitoring at the cash withdrawal centre.

The incident came to light when a customer entered the ATM to withdraw cash and found a man lying on the floor inside the air-conditioned kiosk. The customer recorded the scene, and the video quickly spread across social media platforms.

The incident has sparked questions about the lack of physical security and real-time monitoring at the ATM. Local residents expressed concern that unrestricted access to ATM kiosks could allow unauthorised individuals to loiter inside, potentially posing a safety risk to customers, especially those visiting late at night.

The viral video has also renewed concerns over the security arrangements at standalone bank ATMs and whether adequate surveillance measures are in place to ensure customer safety.

articles.title: Hotel Showdown Goes Viral: Wife Slaps Husband During Public Confrontation in Agra
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing a heated dispute between a husband and wife outside a hotel in Shahdara under the Trans-Yamuna police station limits in Agra has gone viral on social media. The clip shows the woman slapping her husband during the altercation.

body.html:
A video showing a heated dispute between a husband and wife outside a hotel in Shahdara under the Trans-Yamuna police station limits in Agra has gone viral on social media. The clip shows the woman slapping her husband during the altercation.

The incident reportedly took place last Sunday. Bystanders intervened to stop the fight, while one person recorded the confrontation and shared the video online.

According to the husband, a resident of Adarsh Nagar, he has been married for 14 years and has three children. He alleged that his wife had been staying at her parents' home for the past three months. On Sunday, he claimed acquaintances informed him that she was at a hotel in Shahdara with another man. He reached the hotel, where an argument allegedly broke out. The husband later called Dial 112 and submitted a written complaint at the local police station. He also stated that if any harm comes to him in the future, his wife and the man named in his complaint should be held responsible.

The wife has denied the allegations, claiming that her husband arrived at the hotel in an intoxicated state and began arguing without any reason. She said the argument escalated into a scuffle, attracting a crowd of passersby who intervened.

Trans-Yamuna police station in-charge Harendra Kumar said both husband and wife have made allegations against each other. Police are investigating the matter based on the complaints filed by both parties and the available evidence. Further legal action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation.

#Agra #UttarPradesh #ViralVideo #HotelDrama #CoupleDispute

articles.title: Drunk at PTM? Andhra Teacher Suspended After Viral Video Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A government school teacher in Andhra Pradesh has been suspended after allegedly attending a Parent-Teacher Meeting (PTM) under the influence of alcohol at Pinapadu Tribal School in Chintapalli Mandal of Alluri Sitarama Raju district.

body.html:
A government school teacher in Andhra Pradesh has been suspended after allegedly attending a Parent-Teacher Meeting (PTM) under the influence of alcohol at Pinapadu Tribal School in Chintapalli Mandal of Alluri Sitarama Raju district. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

According to reports, the teacher, identified as Korabu Venkata Ramana, allegedly arrived at the PTM intoxicated and was seen falling onto a bench during the programme. The incident triggered outrage among parents, who questioned the impact such behaviour could have on students.

Following the viral video, the Education Department ordered an inquiry into the incident. Based on the findings, the Tribal Welfare Department suspended the teacher.

Officials stated that negligence and irresponsible conduct while on duty would not be tolerated and confirmed that disciplinary action was taken after the inquiry report.

articles.title: Kanpur: Woman Accuses Home Guard of Molestation, Beats Him on Busy Road; Police Dispute Jurisdiction
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic confrontation unfolded near the Kargil petrol pump on Barra Highway in Kanpur on Saturday after a woman accused an on-duty home guard of molestation. The incident escalated into a public scuffle, and a 1-minute 26-second video of the altercation has gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A dramatic confrontation unfolded near the Kargil petrol pump on Barra Highway in Kanpur on Saturday after a woman accused an on-duty home guard of molestation. The incident escalated into a public scuffle, and a 1-minute 26-second video of the altercation has gone viral on social media.

In the viral video, the woman, with her face covered by a scarf, is seen grabbing the home guard by his uniform and pulling him. As the home guard attempts to free himself, the woman allegedly slaps and kicks him. Several bystanders are seen supporting the woman, with some even handing her slippers to hit the home guard.

During the confrontation, the home guard is seen twisting the woman's hand in an attempt to free himself, snatching the slippers and throwing them away. He then allegedly slaps the woman, following which she hits him again. The home guard eventually manages to escape after slipping out of his uniform.

Following the video's circulation, a dispute emerged between the Barra and Gujaini police over the jurisdiction where the incident took place. Gujaini police station in-charge Rajan Sharma claimed the Kargil underpass falls under the Barra police station limits, while Barra police station in-charge Ravindra Srivastava maintained that the incident occurred within the Gujaini police station area.

Police are yet to issue an official statement on the allegations or confirm whether a case has been registered.

#Kanpur #UttarPradesh #ViralVideo #HomeGuard

articles.title: Delhi Tragedy: US Student Dies After Car Plunges Into Open Drain in Vasant Kunj, Friend Survives
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 20-year-old student who had recently returned from the United States was killed after the car he was driving overturned and plunged into an open drain in south Delhi's Vasant Kunj early on Friday. A young woman travelling with him escaped from the vehicle with minor injuries.

body.html:
A 20-year-old student who had recently returned from the United States was killed after the car he was driving overturned and plunged into an open drain in south Delhi's Vasant Kunj early on Friday. A young woman travelling with him escaped from the vehicle with minor injuries.

The deceased has been identified as Yashvendra, whose father is an Army officer posted in Kolkata. He had recently returned to India and was staying with a friend in the Delhi Cantonment area.

According to police, the accident occurred at around 6 am near the Nangal Dewat drain. Rescue teams pulled the vehicle out of the drain and rushed Yashvendra to a hospital, where doctors declared him brought dead.

Preliminary investigation suggests the rain-soaked, slushy road may have caused the car to skid, hit a tree, overturn and fall into the uncovered drain. The woman, who was travelling with Yashvendra and studies with him at a business school in the US, also told police that the slippery road contributed to the crash.

Police said the two were travelling towards Mahipalpur from a friend's house in Vasant Kunj Enclave when Yashvendra is suspected to have lost control of the vehicle while negotiating a sharp turn.

The car belongs to the woman, but Yashvendra was driving at the time of the accident. The woman managed to escape by opening the door on her side after the car fell into the drain. However, Yashvendra became trapped inside as the vehicle's roof collapsed. She sustained minor injuries.

The drain reportedly had no cover or retaining wall to prevent vehicles from falling into it.

Police have not yet registered a case. The exact cause of the accident, including the vehicle's speed and any other contributing factors, is under investigation. CCTV footage from the area is also being examined.

articles.title: Return My Phone!' Couple's Court Fight Turns Into Viral Street Brawl Outside Meerut Court
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A long-running marital dispute between a husband and wife allegedly escalated into a street brawl outside the Meerut court on Friday evening, reportedly over the return of a mobile phone gifted during their wedding. A video of the argument and scuffle has since gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A long-running marital dispute between a husband and wife allegedly escalated into a street brawl outside the Meerut court on Friday evening, reportedly over the return of a mobile phone gifted during their wedding. A video of the argument and scuffle has since gone viral on social media.

According to police, the couple has been involved in an ongoing marital dispute, with the matter currently pending before a court. Both had appeared at the Meerut court for a hearing on Friday. After the proceedings concluded, they reportedly began discussing the return of each other's belongings.

Police said the woman demanded that her husband return the mobile phone she had gifted him during their wedding. When he allegedly refused, an argument broke out and soon escalated into a physical altercation outside the court premises, drawing a large crowd of bystanders.

A passerby alerted Dial 112, reporting that the woman was being assaulted. Civil Lines police reached the spot, separated the couple, and brought the situation under control. The woman was later taken to the police station for questioning.

During the inquiry, police found that the woman is a resident of Meerut's Brahmapuri area, while her husband is from Muzaffarnagar. Officials said the woman declined to file a written complaint against her husband. In the absence of a formal complaint, both parties were counselled and allowed to leave. Police added that appropriate action will be taken if either party files a complaint in the future.

#Meerut #ViralVideo #CourtDrama #FamilyDispute

articles.title: Woman Fights Back Against Alleged Harasser on BMTC Bus, Driver’s Swift Action Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman allegedly confronted a man who sexually harassed her aboard a Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation (BMTC) bus, with the incident coming to light after a video of the confrontation went viral on social media.

body.html:
A woman allegedly confronted a man who sexually harassed her aboard a Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation (BMTC) bus, with the incident coming to light after a video of the confrontation went viral on social media.

The incident reportedly took place on a Route 500D BMTC bus travelling from Hebbal to Manyata Tech Park along Bengaluru's Outer Ring Road.

According to information shared online, the woman immediately alerted the bus driver after the alleged harassment instead of remaining silent. BMTC driver Praveen is said to have responded swiftly by stopping the bus and confronting the accused.

During the confrontation, the accused allegedly spat at the driver, following which Praveen physically restrained him until police arrived. A video circulating on social media appears to capture the tense exchange inside the bus and has been widely shared.

Police later intervened and initiated legal action against the accused. However, officials have not yet released detailed information regarding the case or the charges filed.

The incident has reignited discussions about women's safety on public transport and the importance of prompt intervention by transport staff and fellow passengers.

The viral video has also drawn widespread praise online, with many users commending the woman's courage in reporting the alleged harassment and appreciating the BMTC driver's quick response.
